final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_abs_ownership_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_abs_ownership_gap) AS overall_avg_gap FROM step1) SELECT step1.corpeventprx, step1.avg_anlycount, step1.avg_abs_ownership_gap, step1.avg_abs_ownership_gap - step2.overall_avg_gap AS gap_from_overall FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL
